prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that on June 14th you were observed using the metric system. Respond to the committee.
response:
*adjusts tie, leans into microphone*

Mr. Chairman, distinguished members of the committee, I appreciate the opportunity to address these serious allegations.

Let me state for the record, clearly and without equivocation: I have never *knowingly* touched a Celsius thermometer at a cookout. Not once. When my ribs reached what some might call "63 degrees," I want this committee to understand that I was measuring in a spirit of pure American Fahrenheit, and any confusion is the fault of a mislabeled foreign import at the hardware store.

Now, regarding June 14th. I acknowledge I was present at a backyard gathering. I acknowledge there were brats on the grill. But this notion that I asked someone to "hand me that liter of soda"—Mr. Chairman, I categorically deny it. It was a two-liter bottle, purchased as-is, and I refuse to be held accountable for the sins of the Coca-Cola Company's packaging department.

*points finger*

And I'll tell you what else. I've seen the way some of my neighbors talk. Fella down the street said his burger patty was "a hundred grams." A hundred grams! In MY cul-de-sac! I reported him, as any patriot would.
